# Half marathon prep

- Intervals on Wednesday: six times 800 metres with two minutes rest.
- Strength training twice a week keeps the injuries away.
- Knee felt sore after the hill session, skip hills this week.
- Weekly distance goes up by at most ten percent.
- Iris joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day.
- New shoes after 700 kilometres, the old ones are flat.
